# MotionHotel

> MotionHotel is a premium, fully static Astro 7 theme for fictional boutique hotels, retreats and design-led stays. It does not require a CMS and uses local, responsive AVIF image optimisation plus Motion-powered interface animation.

This demonstration website uses placeholder hotel details and the `motionhotel.example` domain. Before deployment, replace the domain, contact information, booking recipient and legal placeholders with production values.

## Main pages

- [Homepage](https://motionhotel.example/): Overview of the fictional hotel, rooms, rituals, editorial stories and contact call to action.
- [Rooms and suites](https://motionhotel.example/rooms): Room overview with individual pages for each suite.
- [Experiences](https://motionhotel.example/experiences): Hotel rituals, dining and wellbeing content.
- [Journal](https://motionhotel.example/journal): Editorial travel and hotel stories.
- [Contact and reservations](https://motionhotel.example/contact): Static mailto-based availability request form.
- [About MotionHotel](https://motionhotel.example/about): Hotel story, values and design philosophy.

## Guest information

- [Booking terms](https://motionhotel.example/terms): Adaptable booking-conditions template.
- [Privacy policy](https://motionhotel.example/privacy): Adaptable privacy-policy template.
- [Cookie policy](https://motionhotel.example/cookies): Cookie and consent-management template.
- [Imprint](https://motionhotel.example/imprint): Adaptable legal provider-information template.

## Technical resources

- [Robots policy](https://motionhotel.example/robots.txt): Crawling guidance and sitemap location.
- [XML sitemap](https://motionhotel.example/sitemap.xml): Indexable public pages.

## Optional

- [Theme creator](https://noel.marketing/astro-themes/): Noel Dario Andres Astro Themes.
